body:
Avoid the sampled remote-read label merge when no external labels are configured. `ToQueryResult` has already materialized the response labels, and this path does not modify them before encoding. Reads with configured external labels retain the existing merge and source-label precedence.

Adds a focused endpoint test and a benchmark across returned-series and label counts. Checked with `go test -race ./storage/remote -count=1 -run '^(TestMergeLabels|TestSampledReadEndpoint|TestSampledReadEndpointWithoutExternalLabels)$'`, `go test --tags=dedupelabels ./storage/remote -count=1 -run '^(TestMergeLabels|TestSampledReadEndpoint|TestSampledReadEndpointWithoutExternalLabels)$'`, and `golangci-lint run` for the default, `slicelabels`, and `dedupelabels` configurations.
